description: BasePost by basepost.base.eth: The internet used to be fun. Now every article comes with 47 ads, 12 popups, and a newsletter signup that won't take no for an answer. BasePost brings back the good old days: clean pages, good writing, and you pay a few cents for what you actually want to read.
